scope: EE single-function pilot; not global project coverage

evidence.toolchain: SN Systems ProDG EE GCC 2.95.3-EE (SN BUILD 1.36), -O2 -G8 -fomit-frame-pointer
evidence.method: The target relocatable object was reconstructed locally from verified disassembly with the call relocation restored. Target and reconstructed-source objects were linked at the original function address; both linked 40-byte windows matched the recorded original reference hash.
limitations: The target object is a local reconstructed split, not an original pre-link object.
The relocation was restored from the observed call target and corroborated by the candidate object.
This one-function pilot does not estimate coverage of the executable or game.
Runtime behavior for this short function has not been confirmed.
